data.desc: Scinai Immunotherapeutics Ltd. (Nasdaq: SCNI) is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing innovative therapies for inflammation and immunology. Its wholly owned subsidiary, Scinai Biopharma Services Ltd., operates a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO), serving biotechnology and pharmaceutical customers through facilities in Jerusalem and Yavne, Israel. The Company develops its NanoAb platform through research collaboration and license arrangements with the Max Planck Society and University Medical Center Gottingen in Germany.
